Voice now uses FFmpeg for supported audio streams, including AAC and ALAC in M4B files.
It also supports more audio codecs in containers that Media3 can read.
The file scan accepts AMR and ADTS files.

This free build has a fork signing key. It cannot update the official app.
It includes native libraries for ARM, ARM64, x86, and x86_64.

The release includes the APK, checksums, Voice source, and FFmpeg source.
Read `docs/ffmpeg.md` for build steps, codec limits, and device checks.
